units.source_text: 「我本來也想上美術學校的，可是……」

en.t: I had wanted to go to art school myself, but...

units.source_text: 「哎呀，可沒意思了，那地方無聊透了。

en.t: Oh, there is nothing interesting about it. That place is terribly dull.

units.source_text: 我們的老師在大自然中！
我們要對大自然充滿熱情！」

en.t: We must be filled with passion for nature!

units.source_text: 然而，我對他說的話沒有感受到一點敬意。

en.t: And yet I did not feel the slightest respect for what he said.

units.source_text: 覺得他是個蠢貨，畫的畫肯定也糟糕透頂，不過也許是一個不錯的玩伴。

en.t: I thought he was a fool, that his paintings must surely be awful too, but that he might perhaps make a decent playmate.

units.source_text: 總之，他是我有生以來第一個見識的都市裡真正的無賴。

en.t: In short, he was the first real city rogue I had ever encountered in my life.

units.source_text: 儘管他跟我是完全不同型別的人，但在迷茫地遊離於人世間的營生這一點上，又和我是同類人。

en.t: Although he was a completely different type of person from me, in the sense that he too drifted bewildered and detached from the ordinary business of the human world, he was also one of my kind.
